preparation: tools/prepare_reference_assets.py. BOX downsample, 32-color character palette / 16-color tree, binary alpha. Frame 48x72; ink bounds guests 36x60 / groom 38x64 / bride 44x64. Tree frame64x96. Ground32x32: remove generated low-frequency shading by local-median contrast extraction, apply three-color palette and constant one-pixel outer edges. J/U/W reuse high-contrast flower pixels from canonical variants; H identical pattern at brightness7/8.
rollback: Remove individual manifest.files mapping to use the unchanged canonical PNG. Never run the whole converter to recreate characters.
